title: Whispering Whorl-Whelk
statement: A pearly spiral-shelled snail the size of a teacup, it glides in slow loops through a dusk-blue tank and leaves a faint trail of glowing plankton in its wake. It pauses at a tiny sunken lighthouse of stacked pebbles, where it hums soft bubbles into a patch of drifting kelp, as though telling the plants a secret.
